description: Amazon keyword search volume — returns monthly search volume and keyword metrics for a keyword, or the top keywords an ASIN ranks for. Pass `keyword` OR `asin`. Example: junglescout_keyword_data({ keyword: "yoga mat", marketplace: "us", _apiKey: "KEY_NAME:API_KEY" })

asin.description: Alternatively, an ASIN — returns the keywords that product ranks for

keyword.description: Seed keyword to look up search volume for, e.g. "yoga mat"

name: junglescout_keyword_data
